units.source_text: 阿住高声叫骂，和吓得哭出声的孙子抱成一团。

en.t: Azhu shouted abuse at the top of her voice and huddled together with her grandson, who was so frightened that he burst into tears.

units.source_text: 但是，阿民毫不在意的依旧躺在炉子旁边，假装没听见。

en.t: But Amin, utterly unconcerned, went on lying beside the hearth and pretended not to hear.
